Comment: The synthesis plan requires cumulative dose < 2 mg/kg. Furthermore, the combined outcome 'death or BPD at 36 weeks' is reported as components: Death before discharge (placebo 18/54, dexa 17/55) and O2 at 36 wk among survivors (placebo 12/36, dexa 3/38). The pre-identified effect requested extracting death or oxygen dependency at 36 weeks. If summed per synthesis plan: dexa = 17 deaths + 3 O2 dependent = 20/55 (36.4%); placebo = 18 deaths + 12 O2 dependent = 30/54 (55.6%).
